blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Bennie Boatwright can’t wait to finally get his Gilas Pilipinas stint going in the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers following a lengthy naturalization process. Boatwright will make his national team debut this weekend in Seremban, Malaysia when Gilas takes on Syria and Iran in a pair of crucial games that are expected to see him play a prominent role.
